summary: It is Thanksgiving weekend and we did not find a dated dog meetup or adoption event, so here is one dog friendly holiday lights outing plus dependable spots to meet other dog owners. David H. Ready Dog Park is closed until December 23, and we could not confirm the Demuth Park dog parks have reopened after construction, so call the city before you go.
heatNote: Late November days in the Coachella Valley are expected to be in the 70s, which is comfortable for dogs, with cool evenings and possible afternoon wind. Bring water and a jacket for night outings, and recheck the forecast closer to the day.
topPick: Magic of Lights at Empire Polo Club

picks.name: Magic of Lights at Empire Polo Club
picks.when: Nightly through January 2, 5:30 pm to 10 pm Friday and Saturday, 5:30 pm to 9 pm Sunday
picks.cost: Ticket prices not confirmed, past seasons were priced per vehicle
picks.why: A holiday lights show listed as dog friendly, with plenty of families and dog owners out for the season.
picks.check: Dog friendly status comes from a third party listing, so confirm the leash policy and ticket price on the official site before you go. Expect crowds on a holiday weekend.

picks.name: Boozehounds
picks.when: Friday to Sunday, brunch 10 am to 3 pm, dinner 5 pm to 9 pm or 10 pm
picks.where: 2080 N. Palm Canyon Drive, Palm Springs
picks.why: A restaurant built around dogs and their people, so the tables around you are full of fellow dog owners.
picks.check: Listed hours differ between sites and we found no holiday weekend hours, so call to confirm. 760 656 0067.

picks.name: Palm Springs Air Museum
picks.where: 745 N. Gene Autry Trail, Palm Springs
picks.why: A fresh outing where friendly leashed dogs are welcome, with plenty of visitors to chat with.
picks.check: We could not reconfirm holiday weekend hours, so call first and ask about loud engine runs if your dog is noise sensitive. 760 778 6262.

picks.name: Whitewater Preserve
picks.where: Whitewater Preserve, about 25 minutes northwest of Palm Springs
picks.why: Leashed dogs are allowed on the preserve trails, and cool fall mornings are ideal for a hike where you will likely cross paths with other dog owners.
picks.check: Confirm weekend hours and any reservation requirement with the Wildlands Conservancy, keep your dog on a leash, and check wind in the pass before you drive out.
